resources.string: Type a question, then send. No screen reading or automatic recording.

Choose zero fish AI in system settings, then use the system assistant gesture or button for a private text conversation. Invocation never submits, captures the screen, listens for hotwords or records audio. Hiding or locking cancels and clears this session. Device support varies. Opening settings leaves this page and clears unsent drafts.
This device does not support this assistant selection entry.
